prompt: Which room in here do you actually live in? Not the one you would show a guest.
Find the oldest object in your home. Not the most valuable; the oldest. Work out how it got here.
Do nothing on purpose for three minutes. Not resting, not scrolling; nothing. Notice how long three minutes is.
Work out where you would go if your home was shut to you for six hours and you had no money. Somewhere near you is that place.
